As we all know, we're defending a trade-secret lawsuit where the plaintiff has demanded customer-support files, internal spreadsheets, and source-code materials. Our current draft response proposes ordinary document production under the court's existing confidentiality order, but the plaintiff has signaled they'll challenge any substantial withholding or restriction on access. We have 10 days to serve our response. I'd like to hear from each of you on how we should approach this -- particularly whether ordinary production is the right strategy or whether we need to reconsider our position given the plaintiff's stated intent to push back.
